# Zosia Brinbrook

Zosia Brinbrook is the founder and CEO of Vorrel Cloud, the company behind ClaimTrackr—a leading software platform for automating insurance claim submissions and monitoring approval status in real time in dental clinic billing services. With over 15 years of experience in health tech and dental practice management, Brinbrook’s vision for ClaimTrackr grew from firsthand encounters with the inefficiencies and delays dental offices face during insurance billing.

Early in her career, Zosia worked as a dental office manager in a mid-sized metropolitan practice. She quickly identified that manual claim submissions were error-prone and time-consuming, often requiring multiple follow-ups to verify approval status. This bottleneck directly impacted chair utilization and revenue realization. Drawing on her background in software development and operational analytics, she began developing the initial prototype of ClaimTrackr in 2015, aiming to streamline the entire insurance claims workflow.

ClaimTrackr automates submission of dental insurance claims by integrating with practice management systems and insurance provider portals. The software validates claim data, flags errors before filing, and transmits claims electronically, reducing manual entry by up to 85%. Its real-time monitoring dashboard provides staff instant updates on claim status—whether pending, approved, or rejected—cutting average reimbursement cycles from 45 days to under 15 days in many cases. ClaimTrackr also generates detailed reports on claim performance, helping clinics optimize billing processes and reduce denials.

Vorrel Cloud’s first customers came from local dental groups in the greater Centara region, attracted by ClaimTrackr’s promise to simplify billing and improve cash flow. Early adopters noted a 20% increase in chair utilization due to the faster turnaround on claims and fewer billing-related disruptions. To encourage wider adoption, Zosia led several pricing experiments, including a subscription model with tiered volume limits and a “pay-per-claim” option targeting smaller practices. The current pricing package, launched in late 2022, combines a base monthly fee of $499 with $2.50 per claim, balancing affordability with scalability.

Zosia’s roadmap for ClaimTrackr focuses on expanding integration capabilities with emerging dental practice management platforms and insurance networks, enhancing AI-driven error detection to preempt common claim rejections, and launching predictive analytics tools to forecast reimbursement trends. Planned features include a patient-facing portal that allows patients to track claim progress and expected payments, further reducing administrative overhead.

Under Zosia Brinbrook’s leadership, ClaimTrackr has become a cornerstone solution in dental clinic scheduling and billing, addressing critical pain points with automation and real-time insights. Her blend of operational expertise and product innovation continues to drive Vorrel Cloud’s growth and the ongoing evolution of ClaimTrackr’s capabilities.
